fields.description: Weekly issue containing Wen R. Phillips' "Notebook" commentary on the American Legion convention in Miami and complaints about price-fixing and sharp rent and food increases; local political notes including Miami Beach election mentions; a poem dedicated to Legionnaires ("Have You Seen Elmer?"); extensive radio program listings; horse-racing commentary and betting tips ("Jockey Jimmy") including discussion of a trainer suspension for alleged stimulation; and numerous local advertisements for Miami and Miami Beach businesses (bars, restaurants, salons, hotels, services).
